messages:
claire: Heads up: PR 4810 is blocking a customer migration. Optimize toolkit docs use deprecated quant names and old batching params. Can someone triage?
ben: I'll take a look. Which files?
claire: optimize/quant-profiles.md, optimize/examples/python_batching.md, and optimize/migration-guide.md. Also an embed example links to /docs/legacy/kv_cache.md which 404s.
tariq: Reproduced locally. Snippets use `quant_type: q4_0` and `batch_size`. We should show `quant_profile: q_standard_q4_1` and `batching.window_ms` + `batching.max_inflight`. Add `cache.kv_ttl_secs` example.
ben: Proposed Python update sent in PR comment, simple snippet: `model='redwood/fast-13b-q_standard_q4_1'`, optimize with `{'batching': {'window_ms':50,'max_inflight':6}, 'cache': {'kv_ttl_secs':300,'prefix_kv':true}, 'quant_profile':'q_standard_q4_1'}`
docs-bot: [automated] Linkcheck: 1 broken link found in PR 4810 -> optimize/embedding.md line 18.
claire: Tariq can you add redirect for the legacy kv_cache page? Ben, please add a short migration note about accuracy tradeoffs and fallback to fp16.
tariq: Added redirect /docs/legacy/kv_cache.md -> /optimize/batching-and-cache.md and pushed branch docs/4810-redirects. Linkcheck passes locally.
ben: Added migration note: "q4_0 -> q4_1: expect memory savings and slight logits changes; run smoke eval and fallback to `redwood/fast-13b-fp16` if accuracy regressions appear." Pushed docs/4810-quant-fix.
ci-bot: Build: success. Linkcheck: success.
support: Notified support with migration snippet link so they can update customer playbook.
claire: Great work 44d Merging now, will add changelog entry and confirm customer unblocked.
